source: Uiwang City Council public expense attachments (2026-07 to 2026-09)
method: Independent official attachment text extraction; dates and comma-formatted transaction amounts sorted lexicographically, joined with LF, FNV-1a 32-bit; each period's printed subtotals independently summed.

files.note: One official date printed '2026. 8. 18 18:37' without dot after day; count and amount are verified against source.

publication_rules: Do not split multi-merchant spend into separate restaurants or assign full amount to one restaurant
Non-restaurant purchases remain in audit but are excluded from dining recommendations after verified classification
Preserve existing 85 records and 33 file metadata; do not overwrite NO_HEADER audit history
Keep source HOLD until strict source-scope QA and refreshed official discovery including October pass
